subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Feishu-owned, default-off `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing in the bundled Feishu plugin?
rationale: Source inspection supports the missing capability, but the permanent config name/default and acceptable proof bar for live send timing require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept default-off Feishu pacing after proof
options.body: Review this PR toward merge once redacted live Feishu proof shows configured same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

options.title: Reject the new config surface
options.body: Keep only the existing reactive retry behavior and close or replace the linked pacing work with documentation of that decision.

options.title: Defer to broader rate-limit work
options.body: Keep Feishu-specific pacing out of this PR and make the broad external API rate-limiting issue own any cross-provider queueing policy.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off Feishu pacing after proof
recommendation.body: Review this PR toward merge once redacted live Feishu proof shows configured same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained owner candidate for Feishu-owned behavior.
